function: Indoor CSI-fingerprint localization: multi-agent RL path planning for CSI collection and GAN update of the CSI fingerprint database, judged by positioning error (pp. 1, 8-9).
notes: Excluded as function (positioning or localization, Step 1 rule 5). The learned parts, multi-agent RL path planning for CSI collection (pp. 3-7) and a GAN that fills a CSI fingerprint database (p. 7), serve indoor localization and are judged only by positioning error. p. 9: "of positioning error is used as the measurement standard". p. 8: "Match real-time CSI with CSIfinal to locate by KNN;". The agent path planning is also above the physical layer. No channel estimation error, beamforming, detection, or link metric is evaluated; ISAC appears only as a label (p. 1).
